name: music_viz_multiline
description: Multi-line patterns with different visualizers per line — open Ctrl+M
script: announce MULTI-LINE VISUALIZER TESTS — watch Ctrl+M
strudel edit "c4 e4 g4 c5".pianoroll() | "c2 ~ c2 ~ e2 ~".scope() cps=0.5
strudel edit "c4 e4 g4 c5".pianoroll() | "c2 ~ c2 ~".scope() | "[c3,e3,g3]".wordfall() cps=0.4
strudel edit melody: note("c4 e4 g4 c5").pianoroll() | bass: "c2 ~ e2 ~".scope() | rhythm: "c5(5,8)".spiral() cps=0.4
# === 5. All six viz types at once ===
announce 5/6: All 6 visualizers — one per line
strudel edit "c4 e4 g4 c5".pianoroll() | "c3 e3 g3".scope() | "[c4,e4]".wordfall() | "c4(3,8)".spiral() | "[c4,e4,g4]".pitchwheel() | "c3 g3 c4".fscope() cps=0.5
announce 6/6: Full composition — chords + melody + bass
strudel edit chords: "[c3,e3,g3] [f3,a3,c4] [g3,b3,d4] [c3,e3,g3]".pianoroll() | melody: "[c4 e4 g4 c5]*2".scope() | bass: "c2 ~ c2 ~ e2 ~ g2 ~".wordfall() cps=0.3
notify {SCRIPT} "How did the multi-line viz look?" ["Good","Issues","Broken"] {inspect} blocking
